scope: Actual bundled Movement rules controls, isolated previews, explicit four-field Apply, Undo/Redo and exact Save/reopen, bounded recipe input, locks, native input, stale races and protected Save As. No browser or hardware acceptance claim.

results.name: SCENE panel mounts once, separate from mashup, with visible native file/seed and Keep current default
Preview requires explicit capture and disabled generated modes are never enabled by capture
Default Keep current preview has no effect and cannot Apply
Preview displays all before/after values, units and backend without mutating project/history/emulator
Same seed/settings reproduce exact candidate and movement recipe downloads
All four locks preserve the last preview while Shuffle unlocked advances seed and selects Seeded mix
Locks require an established preview and recapture clears old lock checkboxes and recipe
Failed capture preserves established source, preview and lock UI
Cancelling Apply confirms exact values and retains preview and entire history
World Apply owns only four physics numbers; exact Undo/Redo and Save/reopen retain every other field
Single-room Apply changes its gameplay settings and preserves disabled World configuration
Edited native ROM audio and live tracker state survive preview and Apply untouched
Ordinary edits, replaced identical projects and edits in confirmation reject stale Apply
Delayed preview and replay reject project and option races before publishing or applying
Blank, whitespace, oversized seeds and invalid intensity/preset fail without edits
Paused history refuses Apply both before replay and after confirmation
A failed snapshot restores complete history before any candidate assignment
Notify and refresh faults retain dirty, Undoable committed data
Unexpected model changes outside movement fields are rejected before preview/Apply
Candidate/recipe downloads use protected Save As and do not Apply
Movement recipe round trip restores settings and locks as a detached preview
Wrong, tampered or mismatched recipes and oversized reads cannot replace a valid preview
Delayed recipe read and replay reject changed options or projects
Save As busy/cancellation/failure and stale completion report accurate outcomes
After Apply a new preview requires recapture and an old recipe requires its original base
Seed input keeps native keyboard defaults while releasing held emulator/gamepad input
